features: 3MP Full HD Resolution: 2304 × 1296 resolution at 15fps for clear and detailed surveillance.
4G Pan & Tilt: 4G-enabled camera with 266° pan and 90° tilt for wide-area monitoring.
Full-Color Night Vision: 6 IR LEDs with 20–30m IR range and 6 white LEDs with 15–20m range.
Smart Detection & Tracking: Human body detection, motion detection and automatic motion tracking for enhanced security.
Two-Way Audio & IP66: Built-in mic, speaker and siren with two-way talk support, Micro SD up to 256GB and IP66 protection.
description: 3MP Full HD Resolution: Delivers clear and detailed video in 2304 × 1296 resolution at 15fps for reliable security monitoring.4G Pan & Tilt Camera: Supports 4G connectivity with 266° pan and 90° tilt for wider area coverage without complicated cabling.Full-Color Night Vision: 6 IR LEDs with 20–30m IR range and 6 white LEDs with 15–20m range provide enhanced visibility in low-light conditions.Smart Security Features: Human body detection, motion detection and automatic motion tracking help monitor and follow movement in the surveillance area.Two-Way Audio & Built-in Siren: Built-in microphone, speaker and siren support two-way communication and real-time security alerts.Outdoor Protection & Storage: IP66 weather-resistant design with Micro SD card support up to 256GB, suitable for outdoor surveillance applications.
